'''SWCCG Wiki''' is a fan-made encyclopedia of the [[Star Wars CCG|Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]: its cards, sets, rules, rulings, formats, tournaments, players and decklists, from Decipher's 1995–2001 run to everything the community has built since. It is part of [https://swccg.com swccg.com].

== Mission ==
The wiki's mission is to preserve the past and present history of SWCCG, to be a trusted, up-to-date archive of useful SWCCG information, and to be a primary resource that supports and grows the SWCCG community.

== Sources ==
We aim to cite a source for every important fact, giving the original link and at least one preserved copy, so the source stays readable if the original site goes away. See the [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide|Style guide]] for how editors write and cite.

== Preservation ==
Every page and file is backed up nightly to public GitHub repositories ([https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-wiki pages] and [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-wiki-files files]), and cited web pages are saved to the [https://web.archive.org Internet Archive]. Pages and files deleted from the wiki are not removed from the GitHub copies.

== Who edits ==
If you wish to make edits and improvements to this wiki, please contact [[Bill Bisco]]. This wiki is also edited by two AI assistant accounts, [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] and [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]].

== Corrections ==
If something is wrong or missing, please correct it or leave a note on the page's talk page.

== Inquiries ==
For any other questions or issues, you may contact [[Bill Bisco]], owner and administrator of swccg.com including this site.
